verification.precondition: A new adapter receives sixty-four distinct typed recoverable dependency observations without any coordinator capability invocation.
verification.stimulus: Supply a sixty-fifth distinct recoverable observation, then replay the exact sixty-fourth observation against the prior valid state.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The sixty-fifth observation fails with the typed evidence-limit error while exact replay returns the byte-identical sixty-four-entry state.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: No invalid sixty-fifth entry is emitted and every retained evidence ordinal remains closed and replayable.
verification.forbiddenMutation: Evidence overflow must not create an adapter state that its own normalizer rejects or invoke a coordinator or identity capability.
